_readme: Manual fallback map of DraftKings draftGroupId values, keyed by season/week/slate. DraftKings' own discovery listing (GET https://api.draftkings.com/draftgroups/v1/) only returns contests that are still 'Upcoming', so once a slate's games have kicked off its draftGroupId disappears from that listing even though the /draftgroups/v1/draftgroups/{id}/draftables endpoint keeps serving it. The app tries live discovery first (see app/dk_client.py:discover_draft_groups) and falls back to this file so already-started/completed slates still render. Each id below was fetched live from DraftKings on 2026-09-14 and verified by inspecting the roster slot structure (511/512 = CPT/FLEX at a 1.5x salary ratio for Showdown Captain Mode; 1505+ draftables across all 16 Week 1 matchups for Classic).
